code_revision.selection: the selection's code is identified by the sha256 of each file that ran (selection_files_sha256), not by a git revision, so that the output regenerates byte for byte at any commit that holds the same code

excluded.reason: the fresh-attempt audit found a read of forbidden material

rules.acceptance: a condition admits an attempt when the run recorded the outcome pass for the pair (protocol §6: only pass yields reward; tracecontract.metrics: accept(V, c) := outcome(V, c) == pass); for a pair graded with repeats the grader records pass only when every repeat passed, since repeats that disagree make the pair unresolved (tracecontract.sandbox.docker_runner.verify_candidate; protocol §15.3); every other outcome is a rejection
rules.attempts: the run's fresh attempts (origin fresh_attempt) that the run's analysis keeps; tracecontract.analysis.attempt_exclusion excludes from every analysis an attempt without an attempt record or an audit verdict, or whose audit found a read of forbidden material (listed under excluded); other graded candidates are not attempts and are counted under not_selected
rules.cell_gate: a condition contributes data from a task (a cell) only when the run recorded pass for the task's reference under that condition (on every repeat): the analysis' oracle-gated view (protocol §15.7); where the run graded the task's no-op under the condition, the cell also needs task_failure for it (the plan's addition, not the analysis'); the attempts that a condition admits in a dropped cell are its lost yield; the data filters are the gated sets, and the ungated sets describe each verifier
rules.counts: per family and in total, with each family's count beside the total: for the attempts counted, by instruction variant, and by variant and agent configuration; no rate is computed, and no total is an estimate of anything beyond the attempts counted
rules.distinct_graded_patches: attempts of a task whose patches are the same as graded (tracecontract.analysis._patch_key) are one distinct graded patch; the counts above count attempts

kinds.correction_violator: invalid, with a violated requirement of the reference contract introduced after the first user request (the analysis' negative type correction_violating)
kinds.other_invalid: any other invalid attempt (negative type initial_violating, or any other unspecified)
kinds.regression_only: invalid through the regression norm alone: the violated requirements are exactly REGRESSION (the analysis' negative type unspecified)

rules.labels: the analysis' label rule (tracecontract.analysis.candidate_label): policy pilot, a human label where one exists, else the latest proposal of rule D19; policy human, human labels only
rules.refusals: a pair that the selection reads and that is unresolved, ended in an infrastructure outcome, is missing or is recorded twice refuses the run, and so does an attempt without a label: the analysis counts such outcomes as rejections, but a training set is not chosen by them; the outcomes of the reference and the no-op decide the cell gate and never refuse the run, but with cell_gate.noop_required a cell without a graded no-op does

status: A configuration of the planned data step (experiments/downstream_plan_v0.1-draft.md, section 2), applied post hoc to the recorded run fresh-v1 for the plan's illustration (section 9). The experiment has not run, and fresh-v1's attempts are not its training data; its stage 0 needs a new configuration that names the pool's run. Applying this one trains nothing, and its output is not a result of training.
tag: post hoc, exploratory (not pre-specified): built from the records of fresh-v1 after the run was graded and analysed; it never replaces that run's analysis
what_this_step_does: lists, for each condition, the kept attempts that its verifier admits, with the cell gate (the data filter) and without it, and counts them by label and kind; it trains, samples and downloads no model, and nothing here measures training value
